quality_check.description: A single vertical linocut-style reference sheet showing palette swatches, carved line tests, speckled dry-roller textures, contour motifs and sparse rust accents on fibrous bone-white stock.
violations: Canvas is approximately 1143:2048, slightly narrower than an exact 9:16 ratio.
A few isometric contour-block samples read somewhat more illustratively than the otherwise neutral texture and line tests, but they do not turn the overall deliverable into a scene.

material_anchor_v2.neutral_material.evidence: The canvas is filled edge-to-edge with fibrous paper and organized material, palette and line samples; there is no enclosing page border, book, doorway, host, character or single depicted location.
